AI Models says which model answers alert investigations, Investigate now and Optimization (frontend/src/pages/admin-ai-models/ModelUses.tsx), and its cards and model choices take the shared buttons, badges and colours (ModelConfigCard.tsx, ModelConfigForm.tsx). rules.why: The dashboard takes a quieter layout and shows its states as horizontal bars (frontend/src/pages/dashboard/, StatusBarChart.tsx). Its Pods window gives the phase on hover through the catalog (modals/podWindowBadge.ts).

The cluster map and its pod cards take the console surfaces of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/cluster-view/). The node map draws a warning pod's dot as a triangle and an error pod's as a cross, and its legend shows the same shapes, so the state reads without the colour (ClusterNodeMap.tsx, nodeMapLayout.ts); the Unscheduled box's name goes through the catalog.
The workload lists take the console surfaces, table spacing and status colours of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/workloads/).

The cluster, configuration and custom resource lists take the console surfaces and table spacing of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/cluster/, cluster-nodes/, namespaces/, configuration/, custom-resources/).

The network, storage and gateway lists take the console surfaces and table spacing of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/network/, storage/, gateway/). The VolumeAttachment states go through the catalog, and the StorageClass summary card's longest label wraps where it does not fit (StorageClasses.tsx, volumeattachments/).
The GPU and device screens take the console surfaces and summary colours of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/gpu/).

The administration screens and Cluster Hygiene take the console surfaces, buttons and table spacing of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/admin/, AdminUsers.tsx, AdminRoles.tsx, AdminOrganizations.tsx, AdminAudit.tsx). On a narrower screen a cluster row's buttons wrap inside the card, and the audit integrity line's separator is hidden from screen readers (admin/Clusters.tsx, AdminAudit.tsx). Rendering only on Cluster Hygiene: the 24px press area each button now carries (button::after with a transform) changes how the edge of its shield icon is antialiased; no content or layout changes.

rules.why: The chat page refines its history list, welcome questions, message bubbles and launcher (frontend/src/pages/ai-chat/, components/FloatingAIChat/). The floating chat keeps the focus in its input while a new conversation starts and has a status line for screen readers under its header (ChatPanel.tsx, chatStatus.ts).
Monitoring and Helm releases take the console surfaces and table spacing of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/Monitoring.tsx, monitoring/, helm/).

Advanced Search, Cost, the timeline, the Resource Graph, the security lists and Settings take the console surfaces of the redesign (frontend/src/pages/AdvancedSearch.tsx, Cost.tsx, Timeline.tsx, ResourceGraph.tsx, security/, Account.tsx). The Resource Graph's relation names, legend and filters go through the catalog, and a relationship line's label is drawn in the colour mode's text colour instead of the line's colour, so it reads at 4.5:1 in every mode; the lines keep their colours (resource-graph/).

The resource drawer takes the panel border of the redesign, separates its sections with dividers instead of cards and aligns the tables inside it (frontend/src/components/ResourceDetailDrawer.tsx, resource-detail/). Its field labels (container fields, Node System Info, host namespaces, byte sizes, limit and webhook types, container and VolumeAttachment states) go through the catalog, so they read in Korean in the Korean console. Rendering only: the 24px press area each button now carries (button::after with a transform) changes how the text of the Show top talkers button is antialiased; no content or layout changes.
